tokens.name: color.union
tokens.doc: Union: the body of a glyph.  Holds 4.8:1 against the survey sheet, and the white numeral holds 6.3:1 on it

tokens.name: color.confederate
tokens.doc: Confederate: vermilion, 4.3:1 against the survey sheet, white numeral at 5.2:1.  Blue against vermilion is the colour-blind-safe pair of Okabe and Ito in spirit

tokens.name: color.unknown
tokens.doc: Side UNKNOWN (10 ids whose id prefix and state code disagree, Contested): neutral grey, an octagon, hatched: never a side colour

tokens.name: color.unionTint
tokens.doc: Union glass: the inside of a carried-forward glyph

tokens.name: color.confederateTint
tokens.doc: Confederate glass: the inside of a carried-forward glyph

tokens.name: color.outline
tokens.doc: The thin dark outline round every glyph (the same ink on every mark: it is the outermost ink and stands off any ground)

tokens.name: color.paper
tokens.doc: The white that lies under a glyph and its lettering so both hold over dark woods and shadow

tokens.name: color.inner
tokens.doc: The white arm mark inside a glyph (a slash for cavalry, a dot for artillery) and the numeral of a crowd

tokens.name: color.ink
tokens.doc: Lettering of unit codes and names

tokens.name: color.tintUnion
tokens.doc: Lettering of a Union formation or crowd

tokens.name: color.tintConfederate
tokens.doc: Lettering of a Confederate formation or crowd

tokens.name: color.tintUnknown
tokens.doc: Lettering of a formation of unknown side

tokens.name: color.tintMixed
tokens.doc: Lettering of a crowd of both sides

tokens.name: color.halo
tokens.doc: The halo behind every letter

tokens.name: color.select
tokens.doc: The selection ring of a mark of unknown side (a Union or Confederate mark is ringed in its own colour)

tokens.name: color.numeralHalo
tokens.doc: The halo of the count inside a crowd glyph (none by default)

tokens.name: halo.width
tokens.doc: Width of the halo stroke behind lettering

tokens.name: halo.alpha
tokens.doc: Opacity of the halo stroke

tokens.name: halo.soft
tokens.doc: Opacity of the second, wider halo that softens the first

tokens.name: text.dimAlpha
tokens.doc: Opacity of lettering when the mark is carried forward (1: it keeps its contrast)

tokens.name: glyph.unit
tokens.doc: Width of the glyph of a regiment or battery below the full zoom (a small side-and-arm mark)

tokens.name: glyph.unitFull
tokens.doc: Width of the glyph of a regiment or battery from the full zoom (default 15)

tokens.name: glyph.brigade
tokens.doc: Width of a brigade glyph (and of a crowd of units under no formation); it carries one ring

tokens.name: glyph.division
tokens.doc: Width of a division glyph; it carries two rings

tokens.name: glyph.corps
tokens.doc: Width of a corps (or army) glyph; it carries three rings

tokens.name: glyph.crowdMin
tokens.doc: Least width of a crowd glyph: wide enough for a two-digit 12 px numeral

tokens.name: glyph.round
tokens.doc: Corner radius of a Confederate glyph (a rounded square)

tokens.name: glyph.outline
tokens.doc: Width of the dark outline of a glyph

tokens.name: glyph.under
tokens.doc: Width of the white edge under a glyph

tokens.name: arm.stroke
tokens.doc: Width of the white arm mark inside a glyph (cavalry: a slash; artillery: a dot of twice this width)

tokens.name: ring.step
tokens.doc: Distance between the rings of a formation glyph

tokens.name: ring.width
tokens.doc: Width of a ring of a formation glyph

tokens.name: stack.step
tokens.doc: Offset of each layer behind a crowd glyph (a crowd is a small stack)

tokens.name: stack.layers
tokens.doc: Layers behind a crowd glyph

tokens.name: text.gap
tokens.doc: Space between a glyph and its lettering

tokens.name: code.baseline
tokens.doc: Distance of a lettering baseline below the middle of the glyph

tokens.name: name.alpha
tokens.doc: Opacity of the grown-in full name

tokens.name: gauge.on
tokens.doc: Show the strength gauge round a regiment glyph from the full zoom (1) or not (0).  It is the placement strength over the unit reference: MODELLED, and not a casualty record

tokens.name: gauge.gap
tokens.doc: Space between the glyph and its gauge

tokens.name: gauge.width
tokens.doc: Width of the gauge arc

tokens.name: gauge.alpha
tokens.doc: Opacity of the filled arc of the gauge (the dark outline ink, lightened so a ring of full strength does not read as a second outline)

tokens.name: gauge.track
tokens.doc: Opacity of the track the gauge runs on

tokens.name: detail.corpsNameZoom
tokens.doc: From this zoom a corps (and a crowd of one) says its name

tokens.name: detail.divisionNameZoom
tokens.doc: From this zoom a division says its name

tokens.name: detail.brigadeNameZoom
tokens.doc: From this zoom a brigade says its name

tokens.name: detail.crowdNameZoom
tokens.doc: From this zoom a crowd says what its units share (a number alone never stands for hidden units)

tokens.name: detail.fullZoom
tokens.doc: From this zoom a unit is a FULL mark (a larger glyph, its short code, the strength gauge); below it a small side-and-arm mark

tokens.name: detail.selectGrowZoom
tokens.doc: From this zoom a selected mark grows its name and the layout makes room for it; below it the selection is a ring and nothing moves

tokens.name: detail.selectNameMinViewport
tokens.doc: A selected mark grows its full name only when the window is at least this wide (px); on a phone the sheet carries the name

tokens.name: detail.unitNameZoom
tokens.doc: From this zoom a unit says its full name: the same mark grows, there is no second box

tokens.name: detail.hullZoom
tokens.doc: From this zoom a crowd shows the true positions of the units it stands for (while pointed at or selected)

tokens.name: carried.hollow
tokens.doc: How far a carried-forward glyph hollows: 0 = no change, 1 = pale glass in a heavy side-coloured outline (the hue stays: never grey)

tokens.name: carried.ring
tokens.doc: Width of the side-coloured outline of a carried-forward glyph

tokens.name: memory.enabled
tokens.doc: Draw the ground marks that remember the losses (1) or not (0)

tokens.name: memory.shape
tokens.doc: The mark: cross (an ink cross) or bar

tokens.name: memory.len
tokens.doc: Size of a mark at the closest zoom (smaller when zoomed out)

tokens.name: memory.width
tokens.doc: Width of one ground mark (a fallen figure or a cross) at the closest zoom

tokens.name: memory.union
tokens.doc: Colour of a Union mark

tokens.name: memory.confederate
tokens.doc: Colour of a Confederate mark

tokens.name: memory.edge
tokens.doc: The white edge under a mark (empty: none)

tokens.name: memory.edgeAlpha
tokens.doc: Opacity of the pale or white edge under a ground mark

tokens.name: memory.alpha
tokens.doc: Opacity of the ground marks that remember the losses

tokens.name: memory.fadeTicks
tokens.doc: Ticks over which a new mark settles on the ground

tokens.name: hull.dot
tokens.doc: Radius of the dot on the true position of one unit a crowd stands for (shown while the crowd is pointed at or selected)

tokens.name: hull.leader
tokens.doc: Opacity of the hairlines from a crowd to its units

tokens.name: pin.r
tokens.doc: Radius of the true-position ring

tokens.name: leader.width
tokens.doc: Width of the hairline from the true position to its mark

tokens.name: leader.alpha
tokens.doc: Opacity of that hairline

tokens.name: sel.gap
tokens.doc: Space between the glyph (and its gauge or rings) and the selection ring

tokens.name: sel.width
tokens.doc: Width of the selection ring, in the mark’s own colour under a white hairline

tokens.name: hover.width
tokens.doc: Width of the fainter hover ring

tokens.name: motion.selectMs
tokens.doc: Ease of the selection ring (critically damped)

tokens.name: motion.hoverMs
tokens.doc: Ease of the hover state
